children.text: Small tag pinned to CAST's top-right corner. +5% coins per stack, MAX x10. Warm 1-4 (gold), hot 5-9 (coral), x10 blaze (glow). Auto catches do not change it; a line snap or missed hook shows LOST for ~1.5 s, then it fades. Hidden at x0. The % shows on the Catch Result card.
children.name: Desc

children.text: One ring per active boost, under the currencies. The coloured arc is the time left and drains clockwise. Time shows only its biggest unit: 1D+ → 1D, 2D · 1h+ → 23h, 1h · 1m+ → 45m, 20m · under 1m → 30s. Gone at 0.

Below 10,000: full with commas  →  8,450
10,000 and up: one decimal + k  →  12.4k · 950k
1,000,000 and up: + M  →  1.2M · 15M
Every coin/pearl/price field must fit 6 characters (e.g. 999.9k).
